Name: Grandpa's Memorabilia
Author: J3ngoa
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/s2bcPzDY/Grandpasshrine.png[/img][/center][center]
Looks like Grandpa left you a few more things besides the farm!
Now it is even easier to keep him in your memories.

[u]Installation:[/u]
1. Download and extract the mod into your mods folder
2. Don't forget you need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ as well for this to work!
3. Get the paint bucket item from Robin's Carpenter Shop
4. Use it on the appropriate items to apply the new textures and enjoy!




[u]Items for the alternate textures
[/u]A Night On Eco-Hill
Bed
'Bluebeeries'[u]
[/u]Brick Fireplace[u]
[/u]Hanging Shield
'Little Tree'
